snippet.title: Green Day - Boulevard Of Broken Dreams (cover by Margherita Pirri)
snippet.description:

The loneliness and sadness you hear about in the lyrics are also called 'home' as a sense of peace, the lonely road we all walk on in our lives is surrounded by silence, beauty and loneliness: a Boulevard of Broken Dreams. It's not easy to find our own way, sometimes on the 'borderline of the edge', our shadow as the only companion, always looking for something or for someone to love. 
A true and distinct portrait of ourselves, and walking alone is not so bad because you are your own best friend. 
I chose one of my favourite places to shoot this video, I love these endless green fields and silver grass reflecting sun rays.

This is a video in loving memory of Giorgio Armani, a great loss but forever in our hearts. In 2015 he chose my song 'say to me' for his Haute Couture Fashion Show in Paris, so you will see an extract of the original fashion show with my music and Mister Armani at the end of the Show. 
Two of my albums are still available in Armani Store in Milan as a reminder of a dream come true. 
It has been a great honour for me, thank you for everything Giorgio.

Thank you for listening to the wind of my soul,
Margherita

snippet.title: Françoise Hardy - Message Personnel (cover by Margherita Pirri)
snippet.description:
'Message Personnel' was released by French singer Françoise Hardy in 1973, a song written and produced by Michel Berger. I decided to keep Françoise Hardy's original version with the 'spoken' introduction. I noticed that many singers covered the song removing it; but it is indeed a poem that gives an original touch and feeling to this beautiful sad love song. I wait for your comments and feel free to share my cover if you like it!! 
Thank you for listening to my covers and songs!!

snippet.title: Green Day - Boulevard Of Broken Dreams (cover by Margherita Pirri)
snippet.description:
'Boulevard Of Broken Dreams' by Green Day was released in 2004. It is part of their well known successful album 'American Idiot'. The loneliness and sadness you hear about in the lyrics are also called 'home' as a sense of peace, the lonely road we all walk on in our lives is surrounded by silence, beauty and loneliness: a Boulevard of Broken Dreams. It's not easy to find our own way, sometimes on the 'borderline of the edge', our shadow as the only companion, always looking for something or for someone to love. 
A true and distinct portrait of ourselves, and walking alone is not so bad because you are your own best friend. 
I chose one of my favourite places to shoot this video, I love these endless green fields and silver grass reflecting sun rays. 

Hope you'll enjoy my version of this beautiful song, I wait for your comments and feel free to share my cover if you like it!! 
Thank you for listening to my covers and songs!!
